purpose: Research-only replication of Chen Hao dealer-state inferences using the immutable V12 500-symbol full chip distributions; investor identity is never claimed observable.

frozen_inputs.ensemble_rule: arithmetic mean of the three model-specific distribution-derived variables; agreement is reported separately

eligibility.corporate_action_rule: transform frozen economic coordinates by (coordinate-cash_per_share)/share_multiplier; fail closed on invalid or blocking action paths

locked_profitable_inventory.age_source: exact checkpoint identity holding_days, noting the production 180-day age bucket cap
locked_profitable_inventory.persistence_definition: consecutive checkpoint count with locked profitable mass >= 30% of float
locked_profitable_inventory.turnover_since_profitable: approximate: cumulative authoritative turnover since the first close above (weighted-median locked cost)*(1+distance), bounded by the surviving inventory's capped weighted age

control_and_profit.inferred_control_mass: mass with holding_days >= 20 and economic_break_even below current close
control_and_profit.terminology: All states are inferred distribution proxies, never observed dealer identity or holdings.

retention.anchor: previous checkpoint's 20%-profitable low-cost zone, corporate-action transformed to the current checkpoint

downshift.applicability: current close within 15% of the recent high and the recent-high/prior-60-session-low markup is at least 25%

consolidation.minimum_cumulative_turnover: discovery-period median cumulative turnover among 40-session boxes with range <= 10%, frozen without using outcomes
consolidation.estimate: current full-distribution mass below the 40-session box floor
consolidation.exactness: APPROXIMATELY_REPRODUCIBLE because the source specifies two months and about 10% but not an exchange-calendar or turnover lower bound

trapped_inventory_crossing.event: first close above a pre-existing upper tracked-mode band after a prior close below its lower band, before the next checkpoint
trapped_inventory_crossing.distribution: static prior immutable checkpoint distribution, transformed for intervening corporate actions
trapped_inventory_crossing.exactness: APPROXIMATELY_REPRODUCIBLE; it is not exact daily CYQKLEN

cyqk.reason: exact CYQKLEN requires the authoritative full distribution immediately preceding every daily OHLC observation; the frozen governed bundle provides full distributions only at checkpoints and replay is out of scope

market_environment.source: PIT-safe equal-weight return and 20-session moving-average breadth of the frozen 500-symbol cohort
market_environment.RECOVERING: not broadly weak, 20-session return > 0, and 60-session return <= 5%
market_environment.OVERHEATED: not broadly weak, 60-session return >= 20%, and breadth >= 70%

auxiliary_patterns.scope: small predetermined descriptive translations only; no arbitrary pattern engine
auxiliary_patterns.slow_bullish_rise: positive 60-session return <= 30%, positive-session fraction >= 55%, low/moderate position
auxiliary_patterns.bull_long_bear_short: mean positive-run length at least 1.5 times mean negative-run length over 60 sessions, low/moderate position
auxiliary_patterns.pit_edge_horizontal: 20-session drawdown <= -10%, recovery to within 5% of the prior edge, then 10-session range <= 10%
auxiliary_patterns.double_peak_valley: two tracked full-distribution modes separated by >= 10%, current price between them, lower mass >= 15%, upper mass >= 10%
auxiliary_patterns.low_position_dense: price position <= 40% and full-distribution HHI above the discovery-period 75th percentile
auxiliary_patterns.high_position_dense: price position >= 70% and the same frozen density threshold

wounded_dealer.near_cost: current close within 15% of current inferred-base weighted cost
